_comment: pipeline_config.json: HOW THE MACHINE RUNS (subject-agnostic). channel_dna (WHAT THE CHANNEL IS, brand/subject-specific) is shallow-merged over this by config_loader.py -- see channel_dna_file below.
_note_channel_dna_file: Moved out of this repo 2026-08-14 to C:\Bakcup_Asus\shared-tools\channel_dna\, because the Merge_videos composer became a second consumer of the same DNA and assets (bgm.mp3, outro_card.png). Whichever project held them, the other had to reach across into its folder; duplicating gives two bgm.mp3 files that drift. Same reasoning, and the same destination, as the WhisperX venv move -- so no single project's folder appears to own something two projects depend on. Kept RELATIVE, not absolute, so the whole C:\Bakcup_Asus tree stays relocatable. This pointer was the ONLY code change the move required: _resolve_dna_path() already honoured absolute paths and joined relative ones against scripts_dir, and channel_assets_dir() derives the assets folder from this path, so bgm_file and cta.outro_card.asset (bare filenames) followed automatically.
_note_image_provider_order: xAI/Grok set primary, 2026-08-05. CORRECTED same-day: xAI is not locked to a 1024x1024 square -- generate_with_xai() requests native aspect_ratio at 'resolution: 2k' via extra_body, which returns ~2048x1152 at 16:9 (true landscape). That's actually higher native resolution than Replicate Flux's 16:9 output (~1344x768), so xAI-first is a genuine quality win here, not just a preference call. normalize_image() still crops/resizes every provider's output unconditionally either way, so correctness never depended on provider choice -- see save_image()/BUILD_BRIEF.md §3c2.
_note_whisper_batch_size: 4 is proven ONLY at 5.7 minutes of real narration (Phase 1's WhisperX-at-scale test, PHASE_1_REPORT.md §5) -- the OOM it fixed happened during transcription (whisperx/asr.py's generate_segment_batched->encode), not forced alignment; alignment ran clean afterward but wasn't independently stress-tested at greater length. Real listicles run 10-15 minutes, 2-3x that. If a real production run OOMs again, lowering this further is the expected next step, not a new bug.
_note_item_overlay_enabled: Off by default -- narrative format has no items.json/item_number and add_item_number_overlay() no-ops harmlessly either way, but keeping this false is the explicit switch listicle projects flip on (in the project's own config or channel_dna, not here) per BUILD_BRIEF.md §8b. See stitch_video_longform.py's build_item_overlay_windows()/add_item_number_overlay().
